items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: See, the people while we were raised, was McCalls. And while we, I think they were the cause we started playing music because their mother, Henry McCall's mother played piano.

ctx.x: That's three of them. See, that's great. That's great.
See, this is the one named after me, George. He's the bad brother. George is Norman and Junior is Henry. Oh, yeah. That's great. That's great.
Is that Elizabeth? Yeah, I saw him.
